With his current abilities, almost every one of them could be useful.
The question was no longer whether a Zodiac Trait was strong.
It was which one could bring out the greatest potential of the skills he already possessed.
Kai first considered Virgo’s Precision Trait.
A guaranteed critical hit on the first strike of an offensive Active Gene Skill was extremely tempting.
With his current skills, he could make excellent use of it, especially when combined with Shadow Dash or Neural Acceleration.
If he could close the distance before his opponent reacted, his first Gene Skill Attack, Spirit Lance, could potentially deal devastating damage.
However, Kai eventually shook his head.
"Only the first strike..."
It was powerful, but it was limited to the opening attack of a battle.
Once that attack was used, the trait would no longer provide any additional benefit until the next considered battle.
His gaze then moved to Leo’s Radiance Trait.
Thirty percent additional damage on his first offensive skill was already impressive, but the brief silence effect made it even more valuable.
Being able to prevent an enemy from using their Survivor Skills at the beginning of a battle could give him an enormous advantage.
Kai considered it for a while before slowly narrowing his eyes.
"Very powerful, but it’s not really the best against A.I.
Soldiers..."
Though he acknowledged that there were also many human enemies, he must also acknowledge that the main enemy of this apocalypse was the machine civilization.
However, there was still something he didn’t particularly like about it.
Like Virgo, Leo’s greatest advantage was concentrated into a single opening attack.
If his first attack failed to end the battle or create a decisive advantage, much of the trait’s value would disappear.
Finally, Kai’s attention returned to Aries.
Reverb was much simpler.
It didn’t strengthen only his first attack, nor did it depend on a specific type of enemy.
It simply gave him another use of an Active Gene Skill without requiring additional Spirit Points, and as far as he remembered, even the cooldown was ignored.
Of course, there would be more details about the Zodiac Trait once he selected but for now, he felt that it could be the best option for him...
Neural Acceleration could improve his reaction speed and decision-making...
Shadow Dash could help him reposition quickly, while Titan Step gave him another powerful movement-based option.
Spirit Lance might also become one of his go-to Gene Skills because of this...
Most importantly, Reverb would continue to be useful even after the opening exchange.
"If I can use it properly, I won’t just get one extra attack."
Kai smiled.
"I’ll get another opportunity to use whichever skill I need at that moment."
That was what finally convinced him.
Kai looked at the three traits one last time...
"Chamber...
What do you think is the best for me?
I think Aries is the best..."
Just like that, he consulted this A.I.
Assistant and explained his options...
Soon, Chamber also gave its conclusion...
[ Based on your current abilities, Aries has the highest compatibility with your combat style. ]
"Why?"
[ Your current skill set contains multiple offensive Active Gene Skills, including fused Gene Skills with significantly higher combat potential.
Reverb allows you to immediately repeat one of these abilities without waiting for its normal cooldown, which greatly increases your burst damage. ]
"Fine...
We made the same choice, so I’ll choose Aries."
The moment he spoke, the system immediately responded.
[ Zodiac Trait Selection confirmed. ]
[ Selected Zodiac: Aries ]
[ Aries Trait: Reverb ]
[ Trait Type: Active Gene Skill Enhancement ]
[ Effect: Active Gene Skills can be repeated once within 3 seconds after activation without consuming additional Spirit or triggering their normal cooldown. ]
[ Drawback: After an Active Gene Skill is repeated through Reverb, that skill enters a cooldown period twice as long as its normal cooldown.
This increased cooldown applies only to the immediate cooldown following the repeated activation.
Subsequent activations return to the skill’s normal cooldown. ]
[ Zodiac Trait successfully integrated. ]
’So that’s the drawback, huh...
It’s still acceptable.’
Kai then suddenly felt a strange sensation spreading through his body.
It wasn’t painful.
Instead, it felt as though something had connected itself to his Gene Skills, creating a new layer of compatibility between them and his body.
Then several more notifications appeared.
[ Gene structure adaptation detected. ]
[ Aries Trait has successfully synchronized with the Survivor’s Gene System. ]
[ Active Gene Skill compatibility increased. ]
[ Reverb Trait has been permanently bound to the Survivor. ]
[ Warning: Zodiac Trait cannot be changed through ordinary means. ]
Kai stared at the notifications for several seconds before slowly clenching his fist.
He had finally chosen his path.
’I hope I made the right choice...’
Kai thought to himself as he decided to go outside to test his new Trait.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: Zodiacs ( Part 4 )
paragraphs: Kai didn’t waste any time after making his decision. If he was going to choose a Zodiac Trait that directly enhanced his combat abilities, then the best way to understand it was to test it himself.

He stepped out of his room and immediately found himself in the familiar sight of his Shop. The store was relatively busy, with several survivors browsing through the shelves while Farrah stood behind the counter. Xinyi and Xian were also helping around the store, carrying products from one shelf to another and assisting customers whenever Farrah was occupied.
Farrah noticed Kai almost immediately.
"You came out?"
Kai nodded. "I want to test something."
Farrah raised an eyebrow. "Your new Zodiac Trait?"
"Yes."
She immediately understood what he wanted.
"Then you should use one of the Aries Faction’s training rooms."
"Training room?"
"Yes. The Aries Faction has several training facilities nearby. Renters and affiliated survivors are allowed to use some of them as long as they pay the required fee." Farrah said.
"The basic training room costs two C-Grade Cores for thirty minutes."
Kai nodded.
"That’s cheap."
"Compared to the cost of repairing something you accidentally destroy, it is."
Kai glanced at her.
"Why are you looking at me like that?"
Farrah smiled innocently. "I’m just reminding you to be careful."
Kai could only shake his head before walking toward the entrance.
Farrah called after him one last time.
"Leave the shop and turn left. Keep walking straight for about three blocks. You’ll see a large building with the Aries emblem above the entrance. That’s the training facility."
"Got it."
Kai stepped outside and followed her directions.

The streets of Cameron City were as busy as ever. Survivors moved through the roads carrying supplies, merchants pushed carts between the buildings, and several people could be seen returning from the outer areas of the city with weapons still strapped to their bodies.
Kai had become familiar with this part of Cameron City during his time here, so it didn’t take him long to reach the building Farrah had mentioned.
The Aries emblem was prominently displayed above the entrance, making it impossible to mistake the building for anything else.
Kai walked inside.
The interior was much larger than he had expected. Several reception counters occupied the front area, while signs directed visitors toward different training facilities.
There were basic training rooms, advanced training rooms, combat simulation chambers, and even specialized areas for testing ranged and defensive abilities.
Kai approached one of the reception counters.
"I’d like to rent a basic training room."
The employee behind the counter looked up.
"For how long?"
"Thirty minutes."
"Two C-Grade Cores."
Kai took out the required cores and placed them on the counter.
The employee accepted them and handed him a small access token.
"Room 17. Your thirty minutes will begin once you enter."
Kai nodded and took the token.
"Thanks."
He followed the signs deeper into the building until he finally reached Room 17. After placing the token against the scanner beside the door, the entrance opened.
Kai stepped inside.

The room was considerably larger than he had expected, with reinforced metal walls and a thick floor designed to withstand powerful attacks. Several mechanical training targets stood at different positions throughout the room, each one capable of moving and responding to attacks.
Kai looked around before smiling,
"This should be enough. Let’s see what Aries can really do."
After confirming that the door was locked, he raised one hand and gathered Spirit into his palm. The energy quickly condensed into the familiar shape of a spear.
"Spirit Lance."
The spear shot forward and struck one of the mechanical targets directly in the chest.
Boom!
The impact sent the machine sliding backward, and Kai immediately looked toward the damage display.
[ Target Damage: 280 ]
Kai paused as he saw it... He didn’t expect that they would have this kind of technology here.
’Is this A.I. Civ’s tech?’
In any case, he wasn’t sure if the damage was impressive...
The moment the first Spirit Lance was fired, Kai confirmed that his new Zodiac Trait was already triggered...
[ Reverb Activated. ]
The cooldown of Spirit Lance was immediately ignored.
Kai didn’t hesitate...
"Spirit Lance."
A second spear appeared in his hand almost instantly and shot toward the same target...
Boom!
The second impact struck the machine before it had even recovered from the first attack, so he was able to get 560 points in total...
Kai stared at the result for a moment.
"So it really works."
There was no need to wait for the normal cooldown, and he hadn’t consumed any additional Spirit for the repeated activation.
That alone made Reverb far more useful than he had initially imagined.
Kai didn’t stop there.

He activated Shadow Dash, and his body instantly disappeared from his original position before reappearing several meters away. The training machines immediately began tracking him, but Kai had already activated Titan Step.
His body accelerated forward with explosive force, and the floor beneath his feet cracked slightly from the sudden burst of strength.
Kai’s expression became more focused.
He then activated Neural Acceleration.
The change was immediate.

His surroundings didn’t actually slow down, but his perception became significantly faster. The movements of the machines became easier to follow, and he could process their attacks almost before they had fully begun.
A projectile suddenly shot toward him.
Kai turned his body and avoided it.
Another projectile came from his blind spot.
He immediately activated Shadow Dash and vanished from its path.
The attack passed through the space where he had been standing only an instant earlier.
Kai reappeared behind the machine and raised his hand.
"Spirit Lance."
The spear pierced the machine’s rear armor before exploding inside it.
Boom!
The training target was thrown forward.
Kai watched the result with a faint smile.

His individual abilities weren’t necessarily overwhelming on their own, but when combined, they created an extremely flexible combat style. Neural Acceleration was just something he had obtained recently... He had tried it in VR World, but only tried it now...
"This is incredible..."

It allowed him to process the battlefield faster... Then, Shadow Dash gave him instant repositioning while Titan Step provided explosive movement, and finally, the Spirit Lance gave him a powerful offensive option.
Just like that, he began imagining different combinations in his mind.
What if he used Shadow Dash twice in succession?
What if he used Titan Step to close the distance and immediately repeated it with Reverb?
What if he used Spirit Dominion and then activated Reverb before the enemy could recover?
However, would he fight against humans or machines?
The possibilities continued to appear in his mind.
However, Kai still hadn’t tested the drawback.
He turned toward another training target and raised his hand.
"Spirit Lance."
The spear struck the target.
Kai immediately activated Reverb.
"Spirit Lance."
The second spear followed almost instantly.
This time, Kai didn’t attack again. Instead, he waited for the cooldown notification.
A few seconds later, the system displayed the result.
[ Spirit Lance Cooldown Initiated. ]
Kai looked at the timer.
[ Remaining Cooldown: 19 Seconds ]
"So the drawback really is double..."

chapters.title: Chapter 368: The Citadel’s Attack and Kai’s Crazy Plan
paragraphs: Kai’s eyes remained fixed on the enormous fortress hovering above Cameron City.
He had seen something similar before, and the sight immediately brought back memories, as he had looted quite a lot from there and even obtained Chamber, his A.I. Assistant...

The flying machine had been called a Citadel, a massive floating fortress capable of carrying and deploying an entire army of mechanical units. The one hovering above Cameron City appeared to be the same type of weapon, although Kai couldn’t tell whether it belonged to the same machine civilization that had attacked them before.
What concerned him more was that this Citadel had already begun deploying its forces.

Several large flying machines emerged from the fortress and quickly spread across the sky. Their wide, angular bodies were stabilized by twin rotors, while multiple weapons were mounted beneath their armored frames.
"Impulse..."
Kai recognized the aerial gunships immediately.
Several Impulses separated from the Citadel and began moving toward different areas of Cameron City.
Their weapon systems were already charging, and Kai could tell that they were preparing to attack the city’s defenses.
However, the Impulses were only the beginning.
A much larger machine slowly emerged from beneath the Citadel.

Unlike the gunships, it had a massive disk-shaped body and no visible rotors or engines. It simply hovered in the air, supported by an anti-gravity system that allowed the enormous vessel to remain suspended above the battlefield.
Kai immediately recognized it.
"Dominion..."
The Advanced War Machine moved into position above the city before several hatches opened along its underside.
A moment later, something began pouring out of the vessel.

At first, Kai thought they were ordinary drones, but the sheer number of them quickly made him realize that they were something else. Modified Swarmer Bombers emerged from the Dominion in large groups, spreading throughout the sky before beginning their descent toward Cameron City.

The Dominion wasn’t meant to function as a simple assault weapon. Its purpose was to control the battlefield by continuously deploying smaller units wherever they were needed. While the Impulses could provide direct firepower, the Dominion could keep sending bombers into the battlefield and force the defenders to divide their attention.
’They’re not attacking with everything at once.’
Kai understood what the machine civilization was doing... They’re establishing control of the battlefield first.
Then another group of machines appeared beneath the Citadel.
These ones were much smaller than the Impulses, with long, segmented bodies that gave them the appearance of enormous mechanical snakes.
They moved quickly through the air before descending toward the outskirts of the city.
Kai immediately recognized them as well.
"It’s the Fangs this time..."
Each Fang was capable of carrying five Sentinels, and Kai knew exactly what that meant.
The moment the machines reached the appropriate altitude, their bodies opened, releasing the humanoid robots stored inside.
Five Sentinels dropped from each Fang.

The machines landed heavily on the ground before immediately moving toward the city. Each one stood roughly two meters tall, with their metallic bodies designed to withstand attacks while their mechanical weapons were already being brought into position.
"They’re sending ground forces too."
The more he watched, the clearer the situation became.
The machine civilization wasn’t simply attempting to bombard Cameron City from the sky. The Citadel was deploying a strong invasion force, with different units assigned to different roles.
Yet despite the terrifying display above the city, Kai didn’t immediately feel panic.
Instead, he looked around and noticed something else.
Cameron City had already begun responding.

The moment the Citadel appeared, the city’s defensive systems had activated. Powerful barriers expanded across the outer districts, creating multiple layers of protection around the buildings. Defensive turrets rotated toward the sky, their targeting systems locking onto the incoming machines, while heavy machine guns mounted along the city’s defensive positions began firing controlled bursts.
At the same time, Survivors were rushing through the streets.
Some were heading toward the defensive positions, while others were already gathering their weapons and preparing to intercept the machines that managed to break through the outer defenses.
Cameron City wasn’t some ordinary settlement that could be destroyed simply because a Citadel appeared above it.

There were countless powerful Survivors living inside the city, along with several major factions, advanced weapons, defensive systems, and enough high-level combatants to make any enemy think twice before attempting a direct assault.
Then the first group of Impulse Gunships opened fire...
A series of powerful projectiles streaked across the sky and slammed into the city’s outer barrier.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The enormous defensive field rippled violently with every impact, but it remained intact.
Almost immediately, Cameron City’s defenses responded...
Dozens of concentrated energy attacks shot upward from the defensive turrets and struck one of the Impulses.
Boom!
One of the gunships shook violently in midair with its armor breaking apart in several places, but it somehow managed to stabilize itself and continue flying.
Kai watched the exchange carefully.
The machines had the advantage in numbers and firepower, but Cameron City had something the machine civilization couldn’t easily account for.
People...
Survivors began appearing on rooftops and defensive platforms, some wielding powerful Gene Skills while others operated heavy weapons.
The entire city seemed to awaken as more and more defenders joined the battle.
Another swarm of modified Swarmer Bombers descended from the Dominion, but this time, the city’s ranged fighters opened fire.
The sky immediately erupted with explosions.
Some bombers were destroyed before they could reach the barrier... Others managed to slip through the barrage and continued toward the city, forcing the defensive forces to divide their attention.
At the outskirts, the first group of Sentinels reached the city’s defensive line.
Several Survivors immediately rushed forward to intercept them.
The battle had begun...
Kai’s gaze slowly returned to the enormous Citadel.
The fortress had barely moved since it appeared.
It hadn’t fired its main weapons or seriously attempted to break through the city’s barriers.
It simply hovered above the battlefield while its smaller units continued pouring from its launch ports.
’Are they waiting for something?’
The machine civilization had clearly come prepared... And judging from the sheer number of machines now spreading across the battlefield, this wasn’t a simple raid.
But soon, his confusion was cleared...
As expected, the Citadel soon dropped twelve humanoid machines...
The Ascendant Units had finally arrived.
Kai couldn’t help but smile at this as he consulted Chamber...
"Chamber... What do you think of infiltrating the Citadel?"

chapters.title: Chapter 369: Flight
paragraphs: Chamber remained silent for several seconds as it processed Kai’s question.
[ Infiltration is possible. However, the probability of reaching the Citadel without being detected is currently low. ]
Kai looked up at the enormous fortress hovering above Cameron City and nodded.
[ The probability is based on the Citadel’s current defensive formation, the number of hostile aerial units surrounding it, and the detection systems currently operating around the fortress. ]
Kai couldn’t help but smile.
"Well... I expected that much."

Kai wasn’t particularly concerned by the number. Still, it just meant that a direct approach would be difficult, and Kai had no intention of flying straight toward the Citadel while hundreds of machines were already filling the sky.
Instead, he needed an opening.
Fortunately, Cameron City was already providing him with one.

The battle around the city continued to intensify as more machines poured from the Citadel. The Impulses were moving between the defensive positions while the modified Swarmer Bombers descended in large groups, forcing the city’s ranged fighters to constantly adjust their attacks.

At the same time, the Fangs continued transporting Sentinels toward the ground, and the arrival of the twelve Ascendant Units had caused even more powerful Survivors to begin moving toward the outer districts.
Then, hundreds of figures suddenly shot into the sky from different parts of Cameron City.
"This is crazy..." Kai muttered as he could see that chaos happening.
Soon, his attention shifted to a group of Survivors...
They were Survivors riding hoverboards!
The hoverboards were clearly designed for combat, allowing their users to move through the air while carrying weapons or activating their Gene Skills.
Hundreds of them quickly spread across the battlefield, heading toward the Impulses and modified Swarmer Bombers that had entered the city’s airspace!
The appearance of so many airborne Survivors immediately changed the situation.
The sky was soon filled with flying machines!
Just like that, the A.I. machines could no longer focus entirely on attacking Cameron City’s defenses because they now had hundreds of moving targets to deal with.
Some hoverboard users attacked from a distance, while others moved directly toward the machines and struck them with their Gene Skills before quickly changing direction.
The sky became even more chaotic as explosions continued appearing in every direction.
Kai watched the battle for a few seconds before a faint smile appeared on his face.
"This should work."
He reached into his inventory.
A moment later, a familiar metallic vessel appeared in front of him.
The Dragoon looked almost like a futuristic jet ski... It had no conventional wings, yet the machine was capable of flying through the air using its own propulsion and anti-gravity systems.
Kai hadn’t used the Dragoon very often since obtaining it, but he had never forgotten how useful it could be.
He stepped onto the vessel and placed his hands on the controls. Then, a thought came to him...
"Chamber, connect to the Dragoon."
[ Connection established. ]
"That’s fast? Anyway, help me control it..."
Just like that, the Dragoon immediately came to life.
Several components along its body began glowing as its internal systems activated...
Kai glanced at the controls as information began appearing across the display.
Speed... Altitude... Energy consumption... Navigation... and Environmental conditions.
The Dragoon was clearly capable of handling most of the basic functions automatically, which meant Kai wouldn’t have to worry about controlling every single movement manually.
However, reaching the Citadel was another matter.
"How difficult will it be to reach the fortress?"
[ The Dragoon possesses sufficient speed and maneuverability to reach the Citadel. However, the primary obstacle will be the defensive formation surrounding the fortress. ]
Kai looked toward the enormous structure.
It was still roughly eight hundred meters above the city, but the distance itself wasn’t the problem.
The real problem was everything occupying the space between him and the Citadel.
[ The Citadel’s detection systems are currently monitoring flying objects approaching from the direction of Cameron City. A direct approach would result in interception. ]
"So I can’t simply fly straight up."
[ Correct. ]
Kai nodded.
"Then I’ll use the battlefield."
The hundreds of hoverboard users were exactly what he needed.

Their sudden appearance had created countless small gaps in the machine civilization’s formation, and the machines were already being forced to divide their attention between the city defenses and the airborne Survivors.
If Kai waited for the right moment, he could use the chaos to move toward the Citadel without drawing too much attention.
He turned to the controls, and soon, the Dragoon rose from the ground.
Several nearby Survivors turned toward him when they noticed the strange flying vessel...
After all, it should be an enemy’s machine, a Dragoon!
Still, the surprise didn’t end there...
"What is that?"
"Is someone heading toward the Citadel?"
Kai ignored the voices and continued ascending.
The moment he left the protection of the city’s defensive systems, several machines immediately detected him.
Two Impulse Gunships broke away from their formation and turned in his direction.
Their weapons began charging.
Kai glanced at them before looking at the Dragoon’s display.
"Chamber, can it outrun them?"
[ At the current altitude and acceleration, the Dragoon can maintain a higher speed than the Impulses. ]
"Good."
Kai pushed the controls forward...
Just like that, the Dragoon shot into the sky and the acceleration was strong enough that Kai’s body was pushed backward for a moment before he adjusted his stance.
The city rapidly became smaller beneath him as the vessel climbed higher, but the two Impulses were already following.
Their weapons fired.
Several energy projectiles streaked through the air and exploded behind Kai.
Boom!
Another attack passed dangerously close to him.
Kai immediately changed direction, causing the Dragoon to tilt sharply before accelerating through the gap between two explosions.
The Impulses continued pursuing him.
Then Chamber’s notification appeared.
[ Seven additional Impulse units have changed their trajectory and are approaching your current position. ]
Kai’s expression became slightly more serious.
The hoverboard users were still fighting the aerial machines, and their chaotic movements had caused the enemy formation to become increasingly scattered.
Kai suddenly understood what he needed to do.
"Let’s borrow their battlefield."
He turned the Dragoon toward the largest concentration of hoverboard users.
The vessel rapidly descended into the chaotic formation, causing several Survivors to notice him!
"Watch out!"
"What is that guy doing?"

chapters.title: Chapter 370: Entry
paragraphs: At this time, Kai ignored them as an Impulse moved into position behind him and fired.
Before the projectile could reach Kai, one of the hoverboard users suddenly swept across the attacker’s path and released a powerful Gene Skill that struck the enemy’s vessel!
The attack struck the Impulse directly.
Boom!
Kai immediately took advantage of the opening and continued forward.
The modified Dragoon passed between several hoverboard users before Kai suddenly activated Shadow Dash.
His body and the Dragoon disappeared from their original position.
A moment later, they reappeared several dozen meters away.
Kai looked at the display with surprise...
"I knew it... Since equipped clothes and weapons also get affected, then Shadow Dash can also take the Dragoon with me."
A smile appeared on Kai’s face as he knew that it would be so useful.
If he could take the Dragoon with him, then Shadow Dash could become another method of avoiding the Citadel’s detection systems.
Kai didn’t waste any more time as he immediately activated Neural Acceleration.
His perception improved as the battlefield seemed to become easier to understand.
The movements of the machines became clearer, and the attacks coming from different directions were easier to predict.
Meanwhile, Chamber quickly calculated a route.
[ A possible approach route has been calculated. ]
A path appeared on the Dragoon’s display and it wasn’t a straight line toward the Citadel.
Instead, it passed through several gaps between the enemy formations before approaching the fortress from an angle.
Kai studied the route before nodding.
"That should work."
He then accelerated.

The Dragoon moved through the battlefield at high speed, passing between the machines and the airborne Survivors. Kai changed his altitude several times whenever an enemy unit entered his path, while Chamber continuously adjusted the route based on the movements of the surrounding machines.
For a while, everything went smoothly.
Then an Impulse suddenly appeared directly in front of him.
Its weapons were already charged.
Kai could change direction, but doing so would force him away from the route Chamber had calculated.
Instead, he decided to destroy it.
"Spirit Lance."
A spear of condensed Spirit appeared in his hand and shot forward.
Boom!
The attack struck the front of the Impulse, causing its armor to crack.
Kai immediately activated Reverb.
"Spirit Lance."
A second spear appeared almost instantly and struck the exact same location.
Boom!
The damaged armor finally broke apart, and the Impulse lost control before beginning to fall toward the battlefield below.
Just like that, the Dragoon continued climbing.
The Citadel was becoming larger with every passing second as he looked at it...

Kai could now see the enormous armored sections covering its exterior, the energy stations running between different structures, and the massive docking ports that continued opening and closing as machines entered and exited the fortress.
It was even more imposing from this distance.
Kai’s expression became more serious.
He had already infiltrated a Citadel once in the past, and that experience had taught him just how dangerous these machines could be. However, this time was different.
He wasn’t going there simply to loot whatever he could find.
There was a reason this machine civilization had suddenly appeared above Cameron City.
And Kai wanted to know what it was.

If possible, he also wanted to know where these machines had come from, what controlled them, and whether the Citadel contained any technology that could help him understand the machine civilization even further.
Most importantly, if he could reach the central systems, Chamber might be able to do something much more interesting than simply guide him through the fortress.
Kai looked toward the enormous structure.
"Chamber, can you connect to the Citadel if we get close enough?"
[ Unknown. ]
Kai frowned.
"Unknown?"

[ The Citadel’s systems appear to share technological similarities with the systems previously analyzed. However, the available data is insufficient to determine whether direct access will be possible.]
Kai smiled.
"Then we’ll find out when we get there."
The Dragoon continued accelerating.
[ Warning. High-energy detection system activated. ]
Kai’s expression changed.
"They noticed us."
[ Multiple defensive systems have acquired the Dragoon as a target.]
Several sections of the Citadel were beginning to move.
Mechanical structures unfolded from the fortress, revealing weapons hidden beneath weapni exterior.
At the same time, several aerial units changed direction and began flying toward him.
There were still hundreds of meters between him and the Citadel.
Getting this far had already been difficult, and as expected, the final approach would be even worse.
But Kai didn’t slow down.
Instead, a faint smile appeared on his face as he leaned forward on the Dragoon.
"Then let’s see if you can stop me."
The Dragoon continued accelerating toward the Citadel, but before Kai could get any closer, a strange distortion suddenly appeared in front of him.
A moment later, a massive transparent barrier emerged around the Citadel.

It wasn’t completely invisible. Under the light of the explosions happening across the battlefield, Kai could see faint lines of energy spreading across its surface, forming a gigantic dome around the fortress.
The Dragoon suddenly shook violently as it collided with the barrier.
Boom!
Kai’s body was thrown slightly backward before he quickly regained control.
"What the hell?"
He immediately slowed the Dragoon and looked ahead.
The barrier had completely blocked his path.
Kai frowned as he had expected the Citadel to have defensive weapons, but he hadn’t expected a barrier to suddenly appear around the entire fortress.
"Chamber?"
[ A defensive energy barrier has been deployed around the Citadel. ]
Kai stared at it.
"Can we break through?"
[ Negative. ]
Kai’s expression became serious.
"How strong is it?"
[ The barrier is significantly stronger than the defensive barrier previously encountered at Citadel-9. A direct attack is not recommended. ]
Kai frowned...
The Citadel-9 he had encountered previously had already been extremely difficult to deal with, and this fortress seemed to be even more advanced.
He looked around the enormous barrier.
There were no obvious openings as the entire Citadel was completely enclosed.
Even the machines leaving the fortress seemed to pass through specific sections of the barrier without causing any reaction.
"Then how are their own machines getting through?"
Chamber immediately responded.
[ The barrier recognizes authorized machine signatures and temporarily creates passage points for allied units. ]
Kai’s eyes lit up.
"So it isn’t simply a wall. Then there should be a way to fool it..."

chapters.title: Chapter 372: Beam
paragraphs: [ A direct connection to the Citadel’s internal network is possible. A nearby maintenance terminal has been detected thirty-seven meters ahead. ]
Chamber replied as if it knew what Kai wanted to do in the first place.
"That’s convenient."
Kai immediately began walking through the corridor.

The interior of the Citadel was much quieter than the battlefield outside. The thick metal walls blocked most of the sounds from Cameron City, leaving only the constant hum of engine and the occasional vibration running through the floor beneath his feet.

Kai didn’t know where the machines had designed this section of the fortress, but it appeared to be some kind of maintenance area. There were several sealed doors along the corridor, while thick cables ran through the walls and disappeared into the ceiling.
After walking for less than a minute, Chamber indicated that he had reached the terminal.
[ Maintenance terminal detected. ]
Kai looked ahead and saw a small mechanical panel embedded into the wall.
"Is that enough?" He asked.
[ Yes. ]
Kai approached the terminal and placed his hand against it.
"Do what you need to do."
A faint mechanical sound came from the terminal as several sections opened.
The moment Chamber connected to the system, the display on Kai’s wrist suddenly changed.
Lines of unfamiliar information began appearing rapidly across the screen.
[ External system detected. ]
[ Establishing connection. ]
[ Connection established. ]
Kai’s eyes lit up as he saw it...
"So you can connect. Perfect! Please do it quickly!"
Thankfully, Chamber was indeed an amazing A.I. Assistant.
[ Limited access has been obtained. ]
"That’s fast... Tell me, how much?"
[ Maintenance-level access has been established. ]
"What does it mean? Wait... Forget about that. Can you access their internal map?"
[ Searching. ]
Several seconds passed.
Then a three-dimensional map appeared on the display.
Kai looked at it with interest...
The Citadel was far larger than he had imagined.
The map showed countless corridors and chambers spread across multiple levels, with several enormous sections extending throughout the fortress.
Kai could see what appeared to be hangars, storage facilities, energy systems, production areas, and several other locations that Chamber hadn’t identified yet.
"That’s huge."
[ The Citadel’s internal structure is considerably larger than the external dimensions would suggest. Multiple internal sections utilize spatial compression technology. ]
Kai raised an eyebrow.
"Spatial compression?"
[ Confirmed. Several sections occupy significantly more internal space than their external dimensions would normally permit. ]
Kai smiled.
"These machines really know how to build things."
He then looked at the map again.
"Can you find the central system?"
[ Searching. ]
A marker appeared near the center of the Citadel.
[ Central Command located. ]
Kai immediately became interested...
"Then that’s where we’re going."
However, before he could take another step, several additional markers appeared on the map.
Kai frowned.
"What are those?"
[ Multiple high-priority locations have been identified. ]
Several areas were highlighted, and Kai was happy to see that.
"That’s perfect. What are those high-priority locs?"
[ Machine Production Facility. Energy Core Area. Data Archive and Ascendant Unit Deployment Area. ]
Kai nodded as he understood their importance. He stared at the last marker.
"The Ascendant Units deployment area?"
[ Confirmed. Twelve Ascendant Units were deployed from this location. ]
Kai immediately remembered the sight of the twelve humanoid machines descending from the Citadel.
"So they were stored here. Maybe there’s more? I think we should avoid this for now."
He then looked toward the Data Archive.
"What about that?"
[ The database contains a significantly higher level of information than the maintenance network. Current access is insufficient. ]
Kai nodded.
"Then we’ll deal with that later."
His attention returned to the Central Command marker.
"What about the Central Command? Can you take control if you’re there?"
[ I can. Gaining access to one of their Terminals can allow me to control this whole Citadel. ]
"Do you think we can survive going there?"
[ Using your current Camouflage Gear and my minimal control over the systems might help. ]
"Is that so? Then let’s try!"
[ Yes. A route has been calculated. ]
A path appeared on the map.
Kai was about to move when Chamber suddenly sent another notification.
[ Warning. Multiple internal security units detected along the calculated route. ]
Kai wasn’t surprised...
"How strong?"
[ Estimated combat capability is significantly higher than the Sentinels encountered outside the Citadel. ]
Kai smiled.
"Then I guess they won’t let me walk straight to the center."
He stepped away from the terminal and continued down the corridor.
He hadn’t expected the infiltration to be completely peaceful anyway.
Just like that, as Kai walked deeper into the Citadel, he suddenly noticed several small mechanical devices attached to the ceiling.
He stopped.
"Those cameras?"
[ Surveillance devices. ]
Kai looked at them.
"Can they detect me? Or did you do something about it?"
[ Unfortunately, I can’t control all of them. They have detected your presence. ]
Kai wryly smiled after hearing that...
"Well, can you at least disable the one pointing at me right now?"
[ Limited control over the local security network is available if I focus on it. ]
Just like that, the cameras around him suddenly stopped moving.
Kai smiled.
"That’s useful."
[ It’s temporary. Additional surveillance devices have also been identified along the route. They can be temporarily disabled. ]
"Do it."
[ Understood. ]
One after another, the surveillance devices along Kai’s path stopped functioning.
Although he was already detected, Kai couldn’t help but smile.
Several minutes later, he reached a large metal door.
The door was much thicker than the others he had passed.
[ This section is protected by an independent security system. External network access is insufficient to open the door. ]
Kai smiled.
"Then I’ll open it myself... Spirit Lance."
A condensed spear of Spirit appeared in his palm before shooting toward the door.
Boom!
The impact caused the metal to bend inward.
Kai immediately activated Reverb.
"Spirit Lance."
The second spear struck the exact same location...
Boom!
Then, after a few more forceful attacks, the damaged section finally broke apart, and Kai stepped through the opening.
However, the moment he entered the next chamber, he realized something was off...
The room was enormous.

Unlike the narrow maintenance corridors, this area looked more like a military facility. Several large mechanical platforms were positioned throughout the chamber, and countless machines were stored along the walls.
Then something moved.
Kai immediately activated Neural Acceleration.
His perception became clearer, and soon, he found a massive humanoid machine slowly stepping out from behind one of the platforms.
It was significantly larger than a Sentinel.
Its body was covered in thick armor, while a glowing core could be seen embedded in its chest.
Several mechanical weapons unfolded from its shoulders.
[ Warning. High-level security unit detected. ]
"So this is what you meant."
The machine raised one arm, and a concentrated energy weapon began charging...
"Laser?!"

"So you can connect.
Perfect!
Please do it quickly!"
Thankfully, Chamber was indeed an amazing A.I.
Assistant.
[ Limited access has been obtained. ]
"That’s fast...
Tell me, how much?"
[ Maintenance-level access has been established. ]
"What does it mean?
Wait...
Forget about that.
Can you access their internal map?"
[ Searching. ]
Several seconds passed.
Then a three-dimensional map appeared on the display.
Kai looked at it with interest...
The Citadel was far larger than he had imagined.
The map showed countless corridors and chambers spread across multiple levels, with several enormous sections extending throughout the fortress.
Kai could see what appeared to be hangars, storage facilities, energy systems, production areas, and several other locations that Chamber hadn’t identified yet.
"That’s huge."
[ The Citadel’s internal structure is considerably larger than the external dimensions would suggest.
Multiple internal sections utilize spatial compression technology. ]
Kai raised an eyebrow.
"Spatial compression?"
[ Confirmed.
Several sections occupy significantly more internal space than their external dimensions would normally permit. ]
Kai smiled.
"These machines really know how to build things."
He then looked at the map again.
"Can you find the central system?"
[ Searching. ]
A marker appeared near the center of the Citadel.
[ Central Command located. ]
Kai immediately became interested...
"Then that’s where we’re going."
However, before he could take another step, several additional markers appeared on the map.
Kai frowned.
"What are those?"
[ Multiple high-priority locations have been identified. ]
Several areas were highlighted, and Kai was happy to see that.
"That’s perfect.
What are those high-priority locs?"
[ Machine Production Facility.
Energy Core Area.
Data Archive and Ascendant Unit Deployment Area. ]
Kai nodded as he understood their importance.
He stared at the last marker.
"The Ascendant Units deployment area?"
[ Confirmed.
Twelve Ascendant Units were deployed from this location. ]
Kai immediately remembered the sight of the twelve humanoid machines descending from the Citadel.
"So they were stored here.
Maybe there’s more?
I think we should avoid this for now."
He then looked toward the Data Archive.
"What about that?"
[ The database contains a significantly higher level of information than the maintenance network.
Current access is insufficient. ]
Kai nodded.
"Then we’ll deal with that later."
His attention returned to the Central Command marker.
"What about the Central Command?
Can you take control if you’re there?"
[ I can.
Gaining access to one of their Terminals can allow me to control this whole Citadel. ]
"Do you think we can survive going there?"
[ Using your current Camouflage Gear and my minimal control over the systems might help. ]
"Is that so?
Then let’s try!"
[ Yes.
A route has been calculated. ]
A path appeared on the map.
Kai was about to move when Chamber suddenly sent another notification.
[ Warning.
Multiple internal security units detected along the calculated route. ]
Kai wasn’t surprised...
"How strong?"
[ Estimated combat capability is significantly higher than the Sentinels encountered outside the Citadel. ]
Kai smiled.
"Then I guess they won’t let me walk straight to the center."
He stepped away from the terminal and continued down the corridor.
He hadn’t expected the infiltration to be completely peaceful anyway.
Just like that, as Kai walked deeper into the Citadel, he suddenly noticed several small mechanical devices attached to the ceiling.
He stopped.
"Those cameras?"
[ Surveillance devices. ]
Kai looked at them.
"Can they detect me?
Or did you do something about it?"
[ Unfortunately, I can’t control all of them.
They have detected your presence. ]
Kai wryly smiled after hearing that...
"Well, can you at least disable the one pointing at me right now?"
[ Limited control over the local security network is available if I focus on it. ]
Just like that, the cameras around him suddenly stopped moving.
Kai smiled.
"That’s useful."
[ It’s temporary.
Additional surveillance devices have also been identified along the route.
They can be temporarily disabled. ]
"Do it."
[ Understood. ]
One after another, the surveillance devices along Kai’s path stopped functioning.
Although he was already detected, Kai couldn’t help but smile.
Several minutes later, he reached a large metal door.
The door was much thicker than the others he had passed.
[ This section is protected by an independent security system.
External network access is insufficient to open the door. ]
Kai smiled.
"Then I’ll open it myself...
Spirit Lance."
A condensed spear of Spirit appeared in his palm before shooting toward the door.
Boom!
The impact caused the metal to bend inward.
Kai immediately activated Reverb.
"Spirit Lance."
The second spear struck the exact same location...
Boom!
Then, after a few more forceful attacks, the damaged section finally broke apart, and Kai stepped through the opening.
However, the moment he entered the next chamber, he realized something was off...
The room was enormous.
Unlike the narrow maintenance corridors, this area looked more like a military facility.
Several large mechanical platforms were positioned throughout the chamber, and countless machines were stored along the walls.
Then something moved.
Kai immediately activated Neural Acceleration.
His perception became clearer, and soon, he found a massive humanoid machine slowly stepping out from behind one of the platforms.
It was significantly larger than a Sentinel.
Its body was covered in thick armor, while a glowing core could be seen embedded in its chest.
Several mechanical weapons unfolded from its shoulders.
[ Warning.
High-level security unit detected. ]
"So this is what you meant."
The machine raised one arm, and a concentrated energy weapon began charging...
"Laser?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Hidden Quest
paragraphs: The first Aetherium Cannon Ball detonated.
BOOM!

A violent wave of energy erupted from the center of the distribution junction, instantly tearing through the surrounding machinery. The enormous wires and pipelines began shaking violently as cracks spread across their surfaces, and soon, streams of unstable energy burst from several damaged sections.
Kai felt a little nervous since he was still basically within the Floating Citadel.
"That was only one..."
Before he could say anything else, the second Aetherium Cannon Ball exploded.
BOOM!
Then the third...
BOOM!
The fourth followed almost immediately.
BOOM!

The entire chamber began to collapse as the explosions overlapped with one another. Massive pieces of machinery were torn from their mounts and thrown across the room, while the energy distribution system began releasing a terrifying amount of power.
Kai quickly turned around.
"Chamber, how long?"
[ The primary energy network is entering a critical state. Complete system failure is imminent. ]
"That’s not what I meant!"
[ Estimated time until catastrophic failure: twenty-seven seconds. ]
Kai’s eyes widened.
"Twenty-seven seconds?!"
He immediately activated Titan Step.
His body surged forward as he rushed toward the corridor.
Behind him, the remaining Aetherium Cannon Balls continued detonating one after another.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
The explosions were no longer limited to the distribution chamber.
The destructive energy was spreading through the Citadel’s internal systems, causing entire sections of the fortress to lose power.

Lights started weakening before shutting down completely... Just like that, doors opened and closed without control, and several machines suddenly stopped moving as their energy supplies were interrupted.
Emergency alarms activated throughout the fortress.
At the same time, the twelve Ascendant Units finally entered the destroyed chamber.
They stopped almost simultaneously.
Their mechanical bodies were surrounded by the flashing red emergency lights as they looked toward the rapidly collapsing energy distribution system.
Then another explosion erupted.
BOOM!
The entire chamber shook.
The Ascendant Units immediately moved forward.
However, there was no longer anyone there.
Kai had already disappeared into the corridor.
"Chamber, give me the fastest route out."
[ Calculating. ]
Kai didn’t wait for the answer.
He activated Neural Acceleration.

His perception instantly heightened as the chaotic environment around him became much easier to understand. Even though the Citadel was shaking violently, Kai could still identify the safest paths through the collapsing corridors.
Several sections ahead were already beginning to collapse.
Kai immediately changed direction and saw a massive metal beam crashed down in front of him.
He activated Shadow Dash.
His body disappeared and reappeared on the other side before he continued running.
Another section of the corridor collapsed.
Kai activated Titan Step and surged forward, narrowly passing beneath the falling debris.
Behind him, the Ascendant Units continued pursuing.
They were much faster than Kai had expected.
One of them suddenly accelerated through the corridor, its enormous body tearing through the damaged structures as if they weren’t there.
Kai glanced backward.
"These things are persistent!"
[ The Ascendant Units are maintaining pursuit. ]
"Yeah, I noticed!"
Kai gritted his teeth and accelerated again.
Then Chamber finally responded.
[ An emergency launch route has been identified. ]
Kai’s eyes lit up.
"Where?"
[ Approximately one hundred and eighty meters ahead. The route leads to an external maintenance hatch located on the western side of the Citadel. ]
Kai immediately understood what Chamber was implying.
"Perfect."
He changed direction. The western side of the Citadel was facing away from the densest sections of Cameron City.
If the fortress exploded there, the majority of the debris would fall outside the city.
Kai continued rushing through the corridors while the entire Citadel began shaking more violently.
The energy destabilization was reaching a critical point.
BOOM!
Another explosion erupted somewhere above him.
The ceiling cracked and Kai didn’t slow down.
He activated Shadow Dash and just like that, his body disappeared and reappeared farther ahead, allowing him to bypass another collapsing section.
Then he saw it... A large mechanical hatch was positioned at the end of the corridor.
"That’s my exit."
He rushed toward it as the hatch suddenly began closing.
"Chamber!"
[ The emergency system is attempting to seal the hatch. ]
"Can you stop it?"
[ Negative. ]
Kai cursed as he realized that the hatch was already halfway closed.
He immediately activated Titan Step.
His body exploded forward with tremendous force.
BOOM!
Kai slammed into the narrowing opening and forced himself through just before the massive metal door completely sealed.
Thud!
The moment he emerged, the enormous Citadel appeared above him.
Kai stared upward and confirmed that the fortress that had looked so imposing only moments ago was now covered in cracks of unstable energy.
Sections of its outer armor were beginning to break apart, while several explosions erupted across its surface.
The Citadel was dying.
Kai immediately summoned the Dragoon from his inventory.
The moment the jet-ski-like vessel appeared beneath him, Kai jumped onto it and activated its propulsion system.
"Let’s get out of here!"
The Dragoon shot forward and Kai didn’t fly directly toward Cameron City.
Instead, he immediately turned toward the western outskirts, putting as much distance as possible between himself and the massive fortress.
Behind him, the Citadel began losing altitude.
Its enormous engines started dying as unstable energy spread through its internal systems.
"Come on... Don’t explode until I’m far enough away."
Chamber remained silent for several seconds.
Then a notification appeared.
[ Critical energy failure detected. ]
Kai’s expression changed.
"How long?"
[ Three seconds. ]
"Three?!"
Kai immediately activated Shadow Dash.
The Dragoon vanished with him and a moment later, it reappeared hundreds of meters away.
Kai barely had time to stabilize the vessel before the Citadel exploded.
BOOOOOOM!
A gigantic sphere of energy erupted across the sky.
The explosion was so powerful that it illuminated the entire battlefield, temporarily turning the night sky bright enough to resemble daylight!

The Citadel’s outer armor was blown apart as massive pieces of metal were thrown in every direction. Several of its enormous structures broke away from the main body before being consumed by the expanding explosion.
The shockwave spread outward.
Kai immediately lowered the Dragoon and braced himself.
The force of the explosion reached him moments later.
BOOM!
The Dragoon shook violently.
Kai held on, and thankfully, he managed to keep control.
Despite the enormous destruction unfolding behind him, he couldn’t help but laugh.
"Hahaha! It actually worked!"
The Citadel was no longer a fortress.
It was a burning wreckage falling from the sky.
Kai was still laughing when a series of system notifications suddenly appeared in front of him.
[ Ding! ]
[ You have successfully destroyed a Floating Citadel. ]
[ You have fulfilled the hidden conditions of the Hidden Quest: Citadel Breaker. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Last Signal
paragraphs: "There’s a mission like this?" Kai didn’t expected as he saw the notification
[ Hidden Quest: Citadel Breaker - Completed. ]
"I guess this is really an achievement, huh..."
He then quickly looked at the notifications.
He had completely forgotten about the possibility of receiving a quest reward.
After all, he had entered the Citadel simply because he wanted to find out more about the machine civilization. And perhaps, loot a few more treasures.
The fact that he had ended up destroying the entire fortress had been a decision he made only after discovering how difficult it would be to reach the Central Command.
But apparently, the System had been watching everything.
Another notification appeared.
Ding!
[ Hidden Quest Evaluation is being conducted. ]
[ Performance Evaluation: Exceptional. ]
[ You infiltrated the enemy’s Floating Citadel without external assistance. ]
[ You successfully breached the Citadel’s defensive barrier. ]
[ You infiltrated the Citadel’s internal network. ]
[ You reached the primary energy distribution system. ]
[ You destroyed the Floating Citadel from within. ]
[ You successfully saved a Human City from destruction. ]
Kai’s eyes widened as he read through the notifications.
"That’s quite a detailed evaluation..."
He couldn’t help but feel a little proud.
The System had basically recorded his entire operation from beginning to end.
Then the final notification appeared.
Ding!
[ Hidden Quest Reward: 1x Legendary-Grade Gift Pack. ]
[ Additional Reward: 1x Machine Civilization Technology Chest. ]
[ Additional Reward: 20,000 Reputation Points. ]
[ Additional Reward: Title - Citadel Breaker. ]
Kai’s mouth slowly opened.
"Legendary-Grade Gift Pack?"
His eyes immediately lit up.
He had obtained countless items through his Infinite Gift Pack Talent, but a Legendary-Grade Gift Pack was still something that caught his attention.
However, there was another reward that interested him even more.
"Machine Civilization Technology Chest..."
Kai looked toward the burning wreckage of the Citadel in the distance.
If the chest contained technology from this machine civilization, then it might be far more valuable than a simple combat item.
After all, Chamber had already confirmed that the technology used by these machines was connected to a much larger civilization.
Kai suddenly remembered the question that had been bothering him ever since the Citadel appeared.
And why had they suddenly appeared above Cameron City? Do they just want to eradicate humanity? Or perhaps, there was something more, and they weren’t just aware of it.
He had destroyed the Citadel before reaching its Central Command, which meant he had lost the opportunity to investigate its main database.
However, this Technology Chest might give him another chance to obtain something useful.
Kai smiled.
"Not bad."
Then he noticed the final notification... the new title.
Just like that. Kai immediately opened the title information.
[ Title Acquired: Citadel Breaker ]
[ Effect: Damage dealt to large mechanical structures is increased by 15%. ]
Kai’s eyes widened.
"Fifteen percent?"
That wasn’t a bad effect at all.
Although it was a specialized title, there would definitely be situations where such an effect could become extremely useful, especially if he encountered another Citadel...
Kai glanced at the burning wreckage again.
There was no way he could have imagined that his decision to infiltrate the fortress would result in so many rewards.
But just as he was about to check the Legendary-Grade Gift Pack, another notification appeared.
Ding!
[ Due to the destruction of a Floating Citadel, the machine civilization has registered you as a high-priority threat. ]
Kai’s smile froze.
"Wait."
He stared at the notification.
"Registered me?"
[ Your combat data has been recorded. ]
[ Your identity has been classified as a hostile entity. ]
[ Future encounters with the machine civilization may result in increased enemy response. ]
[Ding!]
[ Special Title Acquired: Aria’s Enemy. ]
Kai stared at the title.
"Aria’s Enemy...?"
He immediately opened its information...
[ Title Acquired: Aria’s Enemy ]

[ Effect: Your actions have been recognized as a direct threat to Aria’s interests. Machine-type entities under Aria’s influence will prioritize you as a high-value hostile target. Damage dealt to Machine-type entities under Aria’s influence is increased by 10%. ]
Kai’s expression slowly became serious.
"So they know it was me. This title is a double-edged sword."
Chamber immediately responded through his wrist device.
[ Confirmed. The probability that the machine civilization has identified the individual responsible for the Citadel’s destruction is high. ]
Kai sighed.
"Of course."
He had just blown up an entire Floating Citadel in the middle of their invasion.
There was no way they would simply assume it had been an accident.
Kai looked back toward Cameron City.

The battle was still continuing below, although the sudden destruction of the Citadel had clearly changed the situation. The machines that had been deployed across the battlefield were now scattered, while several of the airborne units appeared to have lost their coordination.
However, something else caught Kai’s attention.
The twelve Ascendant Units were nowhere to be seen.
Kai frowned.
"Chamber, where are the Ascendant Units? Did they get destroyed or something?"
[ Their current locations cannot be confirmed. ]
Kai knew that those A.I. would find him.
"They didn’t get destroyed, did they?"
[ Unknown. ]
Kai looked toward the distant explosion.
He wasn’t convinced. Those machines had survived the destruction of the energy distribution junction and had even pursued him through the collapsing Citadel.
If anything, Kai suspected that the Ascendant Units had probably escaped somehow.
Still, there was nothing he could do about them right now.
He had already pushed his luck far enough.
Kai turned the Dragoon back toward Cameron City.
"Let’s go back."
[ Understood. ]
The Dragoon slowly changed direction.
Kai glanced once more at the burning wreckage of the Floating Citadel before looking at the rewards waiting in his system.
A Legendary-Grade Gift Pack.
A Machine Civilization Technology Chest and more...
Kai couldn’t help but smile.
"Looks like that little trip was worth it."
However, deep within the burning wreckage of the Citadel, something suddenly flickered.
A small mechanical device, buried beneath several layers of destroyed armor, briefly activated.
Then, a faint red light appeared.
After a few moments, a signal was transmitted into the distant sky...
Kai had no idea what it was or what was happening, but he knew that there was a problem somewhere...

However, deep within the burning wreckage of the Citadel, something suddenly flickered.
A small mechanical device, buried beneath several layers of destroyed armor, briefly activated.
Then, a faint red light appeared.
After a few moments, a signal was transmitted into the distant sky...
Kai had no idea what it was or what was happening, but he knew that there was a problem somewhere...

chapters.title: Chapter 376: High Level Survivor
paragraphs: By the time Kai returned to Cameron City, the battle had already begun to settle down.

The destruction of the Floating Citadel had completely changed the situation on the battlefield. Without the enormous fortress supporting them, the machine forces had lost much of their coordination, and the remaining units were either destroyed or forced to retreat.
However, Kai quickly realized that returning to the city was going to be more troublesome than he expected.
The moment he landed, people began gathering around him.
"That’s him!"
"He’s the one who entered the Citadel!"
"I saw him! He flew straight through the battlefield!"
"Was he really alone?"
"Who is he?"
"What faction does he belong to?"
"He’s definitely high-level, right?"
"Of course he is! How else could he have entered that thing by himself?"
The questions continued one after another.
Kai looked around helplessly as more and more survivors approached him.
Some were curious, while others looked at him with obvious admiration.
After all, everyone had witnessed what happened.
While most of the awakened fighters had been struggling to survive against the machine army, Kai had actually charged straight toward the Floating Citadel.
And he hadn’t simply attacked it from the outside.
He had entered the fortress alone.
Then, not long afterward, the entire Citadel had exploded in the sky.
To the people of Cameron City, there was little doubt that Kai had played a major role in its destruction.
"Brother, what level are you?"
"Are you from one of the major factions?"
"What’s your name?"
"Which guild are you from?"
"How did you manage to get inside?"
Kai rubbed his forehead. He was still not feeling well. Furthermore, he had expected some attention after destroying the Citadel, but he hadn’t expected this much.
Fortunately, someone soon stepped forward to deal with the situation.
"Everyone, please give him some space."
A group of high level Survivors quickly approached and at the front was Cornelio.
The moment he arrived, he looked toward Kai and gave him a calm smile.
"Kai."
Kai immediately understood what Cornelio was doing as the latter turned toward the surrounding survivors.
"Kai is connected to the Aries Faction."
The crowd immediately became quieter.
"The Aries Faction?"
"He’s with them?"
"Then that makes sense."
"I knew someone like him had to belong to one of the major factions."
Cornelio continued speaking before anyone could ask more questions.
"He’s currently under the protection of our faction, so if anyone has any questions for him, you can ask us instead."
His meaning was obvious... He wasn’t here to hear them at all. He just meant that they shouldn’t cause trouble... Don’t try anything funny.
The people around them quickly understood.
Nobody wanted to provoke the Aries Faction, especially after what had happened today.
Kai glanced at Cornelio and couldn’t help but smile.
"Thanks."
Cornelio simply nodded.
"Consider it a small favor."
The crowd gradually dispersed, although many people still looked back at Kai as they left.
Kai finally let out a quiet sigh.
"That was troublesome."
Cornelio chuckled.
"You should get used to it. After today, your name will probably spread throughout the city."
"I’d rather avoid that."
Kai shook his head. He had no interest in becoming famous.
He simply wanted to become stronger, obtain better resources, and uncover the truth behind the apocalypse and end this thing...
After saying goodbye to Cornelio, Kai quickly returned to his shop.
The moment he entered, he saw Farrah and the two young employees waiting for him.
"You finally came back!"
Farrah immediately walked over.
"We heard the Citadel exploded, and then everyone started talking about some mysterious person who entered it alone."
She stared at Kai suspiciously.
"That wasn’t you, was it?"
Kai paused.
Then he smiled awkwardly.
"...Maybe."
Farrah stared at him.
The two young employees also looked at him with wide eyes.
"Boss, that was really you?"
Kai scratched his cheek.
"It worked out."
"Worked out?"
Farrah’s expression became strange.
"You entered an enemy fortress that was attacking the entire city, and then the entire fortress exploded. You call that ’working out’?"
Kai laughed.
"Don’t worry. I’m fine."
After reassuring them that he hadn’t suffered any serious injuries, Kai finally managed to escape to the back of the shop.
Once he closed the door to his room, the noise from outside immediately disappeared.
Kai sat down on the edge of his bed.
Only then did he finally have the chance to check his notifications properly.
There was one particular notification he had been looking forward to seeing.
His level.
"Let’s see."
Kai opened his status and his eyes immediately widened.
[ Level: 45 ]
Kai stared at the number for several seconds.
"Level 45..."
He couldn’t help but smile. Well, he had only recently reached Level 40, and now, after destroying the Floating Citadel, he had gained another five levels.
Five levels in a single day. That was an absurd amount of experience.
Kai knew exactly how difficult leveling had become.

After reaching Level 40, the amount of experience required for every level had increased dramatically. Compared to the earlier stages, leveling from Level 40 onward was roughly ten times more difficult.
Yet he had somehow managed to gain five levels in a single day.
"Not bad."
He had initially thought that reaching Level 40 would already be enough to give him a significant advantage. Now he was already Level 45...
And that wasn’t even the most important thing he had obtained today.
Kai’s gaze shifted toward the notification panel.
The Legendary-Grade Gift Pack was still waiting there.
"Now this is what I’m interested in."
He had opened countless gift packs since the apocalypse began.
Basic... Enhanced... and Superior...
Now, a Legendary-Grade Gift Pack was here...
"Let’s see what I get."
He selected the Legendary-Grade Gift Pack.
Ding!
[ Legendary-Grade Gift Pack detected. ]
[ Would you like to open it? ]
Kai grinned.
"Open it."
The moment he gave the command, the gift pack began to glow.
A brilliant golden light filled the room.
Kai’s eyes were filled with excitement as the system notification appeared.
[ Legendary-Grade Gift Pack is being opened... ]
[ Congratulations! ]
[ You have obtained... ]

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Legendary Gift Packs
paragraphs: [ You have obtained ten Legendary Gift Packs! ]
The golden light inside the room slowly faded.
Kai stared at the gift pack in front of him with growing anticipation.

He had already seen what Basic, Enhanced, and Superior Gift Packs could provide. The difference between each grade was enormous, and he had always assumed that the Superior grade represented the highest level of equipment the Infinite Gift Pack System could provide.
But now, he had obtained something above it.
A Legendary-Grade Gift Pack.
"Let’s see what kind of things are inside."
Ding!
[ Weapon Gift Pack (Legendary) ]
[ Contents: Electromagnetic Railgun, Plasma Pistol, Monomolecular Combat Blade, Powered Combat Armor, six Smart Grenades, and one Portable Ammunition Fabricator. ]
[ Energy Gift Pack (Legendary) ]
[ Contents: Portable Fusion Reactor, Quantum Battery, Energy Conversion Core, Self-Charging Power Cell, Emergency Energy Capsule, and one Portable Power Distribution Station. ]
[ Medical Gift Pack (Legendary) ]
[ Contents: Regeneration Chamber, Cellular Repair Serum, Organ Restoration Serum, Emergency Revival Injection, Universal Antidote, and one Medical AI Assistant. ]
Kai remained silent for several seconds as he realized that the items this time truly deserved to be called legendary!
"An electromagnetic railgun..."
His gaze shifted to the next notification.
"A portable fusion reactor... and what that?! An organ restoration serum?"
Kai couldn’t help but sit up straighter.
These weren’t simply improved versions of the equipment he had obtained from Superior Gift Packs.
The difference was far greater than he had expected.
The Weapon Gift Pack alone could probably equip an entire powerful combat team, while the fusion reactor was something that could provide a stable source of energy for a settlement.
But the medical equipment was what truly surprised him.
A regeneration chamber was already incredible, yet the Organ Restoration Serum and Emergency Revival Injection were even more valuable.
Kai slowly exhaled.
"If these things actually work as described, the Legendary grade is completely different from the others."
Before he could think about it any further, another group of notifications appeared.
[ Water Gift Pack (Legendary) ]
[ Contents: Atmospheric Water Generator, Purification Core, Gene Enhancement Serum, Water Recycling Unit, Ocean Desalination Device, Vitality Water ×10, and Regeneration Spring Potion ×5. ]
[ Food Gift Pack (Legendary) ]

[ Contents: One Hundred Kilograms of Premium Wagyu Beef, Fifty Kilograms of Smoked Brisket, Twenty Whole Roasted Chickens, Fresh Fruit Crate, Gourmet Cheese Collection, Chocolate Reserve, and one Self-Heating Cooking Station. ]
[ Shelter Gift Pack (Legendary) ]
[ Contents: Armored Mobile Bunker, Automated Defense Turret ×4, Reinforced Blast Door, Independent Life-Support System, Fire Suppression System, and Portable Energy Shield Generator. ]
Kai’s expression changed several times as he read through them.
The Water Gift Pack immediately caught his attention because of the two special items.
"Vitality Water and Regeneration Spring Potions..."
He remembered that the Superior Water Gift Pack had already contained valuable serums and potions, but these sounded like they belonged to another level entirely.
Then he saw the Food Gift Pack.
Kai stared at it.
"Wagyu?"
His eyes moved down the list.
"Fifty kilograms of smoked brisket?"
He couldn’t help but laugh.
"Why does the Legendary Food Gift Pack look like someone emptied an entire luxury restaurant into a box?"
After surviving in the apocalypse for so long, however, he couldn’t deny that the contents were tempting.
Actual premium beef, roasted chicken, fresh fruit, cheese, and chocolate were luxuries that most survivors could only dream about now.
Still, the Shelter Gift Pack was the one that made Kai’s expression become serious again.
"An armored mobile bunker..."
He imagined what something like that could do in the wilderness.
It had its own life-support system, reinforced protection, automated turrets, and even an energy shield generator.
Compared to the small tents and survival shelters from the lower-grade Gift Packs, this was practically a moving fortress.
Kai couldn’t help but feel excited about this.
"Yeah... Legendary really is different."
The System continued.
[ Stealth Gift Pack (Legendary) ]
[ Contents: Optical Cloaking Suit, Silent Movement Boots, Thermal Signature Suppressor, Electronic Identity Scrambler, Long-Range Sensor Scanner, and one Autonomous Stealth Drone. ]
[ Survival Tools Gift Pack (Legendary) ]

[ Contents: Portable Fabrication Machine, Industrial Cutting Tool, Underground Detection Scanner, Universal Repair Gun, Autonomous Construction Drone, Advanced Navigation Tablet, and Emergency Communication Beacon. ]
[ Transport Gift Pack (Legendary) ]
[ Contents: Armored Electric SUV, Four-Person Military Helicopter, Amphibious Speedboat, Compact Hoverboard, and one Autonomous Repair Drone. ]
Kai looked at the three notifications carefully.
The Stealth Gift Pack was obviously designed for infiltration, with the Optical Cloaking Suit and Thermal Signature Suppressor being particularly valuable.
But the Survival Tools Gift Pack was even more interesting.
"A portable fabrication machine..."
Kai’s eyes narrowed.

If the machine could actually fabricate useful equipment from raw materials, then its value would be enormous. It could potentially allow him to produce tools and other equipment without constantly relying on existing supplies.
Then there was the Transport Gift Pack.
Kai couldn’t help but smile when he saw the contents.
"An armored SUV, a military helicopter, an amphibious speedboat, and a hoverboard."
He had already obtained the Dragoon, so the hoverboard wasn’t particularly interesting to him anymore.
But a four-person military helicopter was another matter entirely.
It could allow him to travel long distances without relying on roads, while the amphibious speedboat would make crossing rivers, lakes, and coastal areas much easier.
Kai nodded in satisfaction.
"Not bad."
There was only one category left.
[ Entertainment Gift Pack (Legendary) ]

[ Contents: Full-Spectrum Holographic Theater, High-End Gaming Terminal, Virtual Reality System, Portable Music Studio, Digital Library containing one million books, and one Humanoid Companion Robot. ]
Kai’s eyes stopped on the final item.
"Humanoid Companion Robot?"
He couldn’t help but stare at it.
The System immediately provided additional information.
[ Humanoid Companion Robot: A highly advanced humanoid robot designed for companionship, conversation, entertainment, household assistance, and personalized interaction. ]
Kai’s expression became slightly strange.
"Companionship, entertainment, household assistance..."
He rubbed his chin.
"So it’s basically a robot that can do almost everything?"
Kai stared at the notification for another moment before shaking his head with a laugh.
"This System really does put everything into these gift packs."
He looked through the entire list again.
A railgun, a fusion reactor, a regeneration chamber, regeneration potions, an armored mobile bunker, a fabrication machine, a military helicopter... and even a highly advanced humanoid robot.
These weren’t simply items that could help someone survive.
Some of them could completely change how a person lived in the apocalypse.
Kai couldn’t help but smile.
"So this is what a Legendary-Grade Gift Pack looks like..."
